sources.snippet: The second step in the process is to use artificial intelligence (AI) techniques for the automated detection of complex patterns and abnormal tissues in brain scans. With the high number of brain cancer cases and deaths each year, there has been a rise in research interest in the automatic detection of brain tumors [16].
